params.1273: Given by the council workman on the bridge south of Rellekka for completing all Easy Tasks in the Fremennik Province.
params.1292: Fremennik sea boots 1 and a magic lamp worth 5,000xp in a skill of your choice.
params.1274: The boots confer the following benefits:
params.1275: - Contact the Fossegrimmen at a distance to recharge your lyre with one fewer charge.
params.1276: Peer the Seer will deposit items into your bank for you.
params.1277: When charging your lyre at the Fossegrimmen's altar you will receive one extra charge.
